title: Glass Elevator building
content: Glass elevator building anyone? seems different than the elevators in the Hospital and Hotel/Red theater. These aren’t as ominous or dreadful as the others. Yet…I feel quite anxious/ excitable about whatever is at the top and only fearful about the exterior impending events. I have had dreams from the inside foyer witnessing multiple orbs/ships in the sky with a sky of water following them. There are people with me and I just remember the sense of wonder
